source_text: \subsection{{Exterior calculus}}\label{sec:exterior-calculus}
translated_text: \subsection{{外微积分}}\label{sec:exterior-calculus}

source_text: {The primary objects of study in vector calculus are functions $\Omega\to\mathbb R$ and vector fields $\Omega\to\mathbb R^n$, defined on a domain $\Omega\subset\mathbb R^n$. In exterior calculus on $\mathbb R^n$, the primary objects are differential $k$-forms which are functions $\Omega\to\operatorname{Alt}^k\mathbb R^n$. In particular, the cases of functions and vector fields is included. Indeed, as we have seen, there are two different but natural ways to think of the functions of vector calculus as differential forms (either as $0$-forms or $n$-forms), and similarly vector fields may be identified with either $1$-forms or $(n-1)$-forms. This distinction, which is lost in vector calculus, turns out to be a strength of exterior calculus. Maxwell referred to it when he wrote that "physical vector quantities may be divided into two classes, in one of which the quantity is defined with reference to a line, while in the other the quantity is defined with reference to an area" \BookCite{58}. In higher dimensions other types of fields arise. For example, a differential $2$-form in four dimensions is a field with six independent components (the number of independent components in a $4\times4$ skew-symmetric matrix).}
translated_text: {向量微积分的主要研究对象是在区域 $\Omega\subset\mathbb R^n$ 上定义的函数 $\Omega\to\mathbb R$ 和向量场 $\Omega\to\mathbb R^n$. 在 $\mathbb R^n$ 上的外微积分中, 主要对象是微分 $k$-形式, 即函数 $\Omega\to\operatorname{Alt}^k\mathbb R^n$. 特别地, 它包含函数和向量场的情形. 事实上, 如前所见, 可以用两种不同而自然的方式将向量微积分中的函数看作微分形式 (或者是 $0$-形式, 或者是 $n$-形式), 类似地, 向量场可以与 $1$-形式或 $(n-1)$-形式等同. 这种在向量微积分中丢失的区别, 恰恰成为外微积分的优点. Maxwell 写道, "物理向量量可以分为两类, 一类参照线来定义, 另一类则参照面积来定义" \BookCite{58}, 说的就是这一点. 在更高维中还会出现其他类型的场. 例如, 四维中的微分 $2$-形式是具有六个独立分量的场 (即 $4\times4$ 反对称矩阵中独立分量的个数).}

source_text: {Actually exterior calculus develops most naturally if we are more general, permitting as the domain $\Omega$ any manifold (finite dimensional, with or without boundary, and smooth enough that tangent spaces are defined), not just open subsets in $\mathbb R^n$. Much of the theory works in this degree of generality, depending only on the differentiable structure of the domain. Other concepts require additional structure: either an inner product (i.e., a Riemannian manifold), or an orientation (an oriented manifold), or both, and some formulas simplify if we use a preferred basis. Of course, a domain on $\mathbb R^n$ is endowed with all these things. But it is enlightening to hold clearly in mind what structures are required for what operations, as we shall do. From a practical point of view, even if we are only interested in solving boundary value problems in $\mathbb R^n$, we will need differential forms not only on the domain where the differential equation is defined but also on its boundary---which is a manifold, but not a domain in Euclidean space.}
translated_text: {实际上, 若采取更一般的观点, 允许区域 $\Omega$ 为任意流形 (有限维, 有边界或无边界, 并且足够光滑以使切空间有定义), 而不只是 $\mathbb R^n$ 中的开子集, 外微积分的展开就最为自然. 理论的很大一部分在这种一般程度下都成立, 只依赖区域的可微结构. 其他概念则需要附加结构: 内积 (即 Riemannian 流形), 或定向 (有定向流形), 或两者兼具; 使用特选基还可以简化某些公式. 当然, $\mathbb R^n$ 中的区域具有所有这些结构. 但像我们将要做的那样, 清楚记住何种运算需要何种结构, 很有启发性. 从实用角度看, 即使只关心求解 $\mathbb R^n$ 中的边值问题, 也不仅需要在定义微分方程的区域上使用微分形式, 还需要在其边界上使用; 边界是流形, 但不是 Euclidean 空间中的区域.}

source_text: \subsubsection{{Differential forms}}\label{subsec:differential-forms}
translated_text: \subsubsection{{微分形式}}\label{subsec:differential-forms}

source_text: {Let $\Omega$ be a manifold of dimension $n$. At each point $x\in\Omega$, the tangent space $T_x\Omega$ is a vector space of dimension $n$, and the collection of all pairs $(x,v)$ with $x\in\Omega$ and $v\in T_x\Omega$ defines the tangent bundle, which is a manifold of dimension $2n$. A \emph{section} of this bundle is a function from $\Omega$ to its tangent bundle which assigns to each $x\in\Omega$ a tangent vector $v_x\in T_x\Omega$. That is, it is a tangent vector field.}
translated_text: {设 $\Omega$ 是维数为 $n$ 的流形. 在每个点 $x\in\Omega$ 处, 切空间 $T_x\Omega$ 是维数为 $n$ 的向量空间; 所有满足 $x\in\Omega$ 和 $v\in T_x\Omega$ 的二元组 $(x,v)$ 的集合定义了切丛, 它是维数为 $2n$ 的流形. 此丛的一个\emph{截面}是从 $\Omega$ 到其切丛的函数, 为每个 $x\in\Omega$ 指定一个切向量 $v_x\in T_x\Omega$. 也就是说, 它是切向量场.}

source_text: {We write $\Lambda^k(\Omega)$, or just $\Lambda^k$, for the vector space of differential $k$-forms on $\Omega$ when we do not need to emphasize the exact degree of smoothness expected. When we do, we will precede the notation with a function space. For example, $C\Lambda^k$ denotes the space of continuous differential forms, $C^1\Lambda^k$ of continuously differentiable forms, etc. We will introduce notation for spaces with different specified levels of smoothness below.}
translated_text: {不需要强调所要求的精确光滑程度时, 将 $\Omega$ 上的微分 $k$-形式向量空间记为 $\Lambda^k(\Omega)$, 或简称 $\Lambda^k$. 需要强调时, 则在这一记号之前加上函数空间. 例如, $C\Lambda^k$ 表示连续微分形式空间, $C^1\Lambda^k$ 表示连续可微形式空间, 等等. 下面将引入具有不同指定光滑程度的空间的记号.}

source_text: \subsubsection{{Exterior derivative}}\label{subsec:exterior-derivative}
translated_text: \subsubsection{{外微分}}\label{subsec:exterior-derivative}

source_text:
{The exterior derivative, which maps $\Lambda^k(\Omega)$ to $\Lambda^{k+1}(\Omega)$, is the fundamental operator of exterior calculus. It is simplest to define when $\Omega$ is a domain in $\mathbb R^n$. If $\omega$ is a smooth differential $k$-form, and $v_1,\ldots,v_k$ are $k$ vectors in $\mathbb R^n$, then $\omega_x(v_1,\ldots,v_k)$ is a differentiable function of $x$, which is alternating multilinear in the $k$ vectors. If $v_0$ is an additional vector, then we may apply $\partial_{v_0}:=v_0\cdot\operatorname{grad}$, the directional derivative in the direction $v_0$, to this function, obtaining a quantity which depends on $x$ and all $(k+1)$-vectors. The dependence on the vectors is linear in each but is not alternating. To get a $(k+1)$-form we take the alternating part. Multiplying this by $k+1$ gives the exterior derivative $d\omega$:}
\[
(d\omega)_x(v_0,\ldots,v_k)=\sum_{j=0}^k(-)^j\partial_{v_j}\omega_x(v_0,\ldots,\widehat{v_j},\ldots,v_k).
\]
translated_text:
{将 $\Lambda^k(\Omega)$ 映到 $\Lambda^{k+1}(\Omega)$ 的外微分, 是外微积分的基本算子. 当 $\Omega$ 是 $\mathbb R^n$ 中的区域时, 定义最为简单. 若 $\omega$ 是光滑微分 $k$-形式, $v_1,\ldots,v_k$ 是 $\mathbb R^n$ 中的 $k$ 个向量, 则 $\omega_x(v_1,\ldots,v_k)$ 是 $x$ 的可微函数, 并且关于这 $k$ 个向量是交错多重线性的. 若再给定向量 $v_0$, 则可将沿 $v_0$ 方向的方向导数 $\partial_{v_0}:=v_0\cdot\operatorname{grad}$ 应用于此函数, 得到依赖于 $x$ 和全部 $(k+1)$ 个向量的量. 它对每个向量的依赖是线性的, 但并不交错. 为得到 $(k+1)$-形式, 取其交错部分. 再乘以 $k+1$, 就得到外微分 $d\omega$:}
\[
(d\omega)_x(v_0,\ldots,v_k)=\sum_{j=0}^k(-)^j\partial_{v_j}\omega_x(v_0,\ldots,\widehat{v_j},\ldots,v_k).
\]

source_text: \subsubsection{{Integration of differential forms}}\label{subsec:differential-form-integration}
translated_text: \subsubsection{{微分形式的积分}}\label{subsec:differential-form-integration}

source_text: {A differential $k$-form can be integrated over an oriented $k$-dimensional manifold to give a real number. Notice that the form degree and the manifold dimension must be the same. No metric or measure is required on the manifold to define the integral, and if they exist, then the integral is independent of them. However, the orientation does matter. If we switch it, the sign of the integral changes.}
translated_text: {微分 $k$-形式可以在有定向的 $k$ 维流形上积分, 得到实数. 注意, 形式次数必须与流形维数相同. 定义积分不需要流形上的度量或测度, 即使存在这些结构, 积分也与它们无关. 但定向确实重要. 改变定向就会改变积分的符号.}

source_text: {If $\omega$ is a $k$-form on an $n$-dimensional manifold $\Omega$, and $M$ is an oriented $k$-dimensional submanifold of $\Omega$, then the trace of $\omega$ on $M$ is a $k$-form on a $k$-dimensional manifold and so can be integrated over $M$. Technically, the result should be written as $\int_M\operatorname{tr}_M\omega$, but frequently one just writes $\int_M\omega$. For example, suppose $M$ is an oriented curve in some domain in $\mathbb R^n$ and $\omega$ is a $1$-form on the domain. We may view $\omega$ as a vector field, and then $\operatorname{tr}_M\omega$ corresponds to the tangential projection of the vector field onto the curve. Thus $\int_M\omega$ is the usual line integral from vector calculus.}
translated_text: {若 $\omega$ 是 $n$ 维流形 $\Omega$ 上的 $k$-形式, $M$ 是 $\Omega$ 的有定向 $k$ 维子流形, 则 $\omega$ 在 $M$ 上的迹, 是 $k$ 维流形上的 $k$-形式, 因而可在 $M$ 上积分. 严格地说, 结果应写为 $\int_M\operatorname{tr}_M\omega$, 但通常简写为 $\int_M\omega$. 例如, 设 $M$ 是 $\mathbb R^n$ 中某个区域内的有定向曲线, $\omega$ 是该区域上的 $1$-形式. 可以将 $\omega$ 看作向量场, 此时 $\operatorname{tr}_M\omega$ 对应于向量场在曲线上的切向投影. 因此 $\int_M\omega$ 就是向量微积分中通常的曲线积分.}

source_text: \subsubsection{{Stokes theorem and integration by parts}}\label{subsec:stokes-integration-by-parts}
translated_text: \subsubsection{{Stokes 定理与分部积分}}\label{subsec:stokes-integration-by-parts}

source_text:
{The capstone of exterior calculus is the Stokes theorem, a far-ranging generalization of the fundamental theorem of calculus. Under relatively mild smoothness requirements on the compact oriented $n$-dimensional manifold with boundary $\Omega$ and the differential form $\omega$ it states that}
\[
\int_\Omega d\omega=\int_{\partial\Omega}\operatorname{tr}\omega,\qquad\omega\in\Lambda^{n-1}(\Omega).
\]
translated_text:
{外微积分的顶点是 Stokes 定理, 它是微积分基本定理的广泛推广. 在对紧致有定向 $n$ 维带边界流形 $\Omega$ 及微分形式 $\omega$ 施加相对温和的光滑性要求下, 该定理断言}
\[
\int_\Omega d\omega=\int_{\partial\Omega}\operatorname{tr}\omega,\qquad\omega\in\Lambda^{n-1}(\Omega).
\]

source_text: \subsubsection{{An example application}}\label{subsec:piola-application}
translated_text: \subsubsection{{一个应用例子}}\label{subsec:piola-application}

source_text:
{Before continuing, we use the exterior calculus framework to derive a result of vector calculus that plays a large role in the development of mixed finite elements. (See, e.g., [\BookNumber{19}, Lemma 2.1.6] for a statement of the result in two dimensions.) Let $p:\Omega\to\mathbb R$ and $v:\Omega\to\mathbb R^3$ be scalar and vector fields on a domain $\Omega$ in $\mathbb R^3$, and consider the inner product $(p,\operatorname{div}v)_{L^2(\Omega)}$. Recognizing the divergence as the exterior derivative of a $2$-form, we let $\nu=v^1dx^2\wedge dx^3-v^2dx^1\wedge dx^3+v^3dx^1\wedge dx^2$ be the differential $2$-form with vector proxy $v$. Then $d\nu=(\operatorname{div}v)\operatorname{vol}$ and $(p,\operatorname{div}v)_{L^2(\Omega)}=\int_\Omega p\wedge d\nu$, where the integral on the right-hand side is in the sense of differential forms. Next, we suppose that $\phi:\widehat\Omega\to\Omega$ is an orientation-preserving diffeomorphism and apply invariance under pullback of the integral \eqref{eq:integration-pullback-invariance}, the exterior product \eqref{eq:linear-pullback-wedge}, and the exterior derivative \eqref{eq:exterior-derivative-pullback} to transform the integral over $\Omega$ to one over $\widehat\Omega$:}
\[
\int_\Omega p\wedge d\nu=\int_{\widehat\Omega}\phi^*(p\wedge d\nu)=\int_{\widehat\Omega}\phi^*p\wedge\phi^*d\nu=\int_{\widehat\Omega}\phi^*p\wedge d\phi^*\nu.
\]
{From the definition \eqref{eq:smooth-pullback-definition} for the pullback of a field and the formulas given at the bottom of Table~\ref{tab:exterior-algebra-r3} for the pullback of a linear map, we see that $\phi^*p=\hat p:=p\circ\phi$ and the proxy field for $\phi^*\nu$ is the vector field}
\[
\hat v=(\det\phi')(\phi')^{-1}(v\circ\phi):\widehat\Omega\to\mathbb R^3.
\]
{The vector field $\hat v$ is called the \emph{Piola transform} of $v$. We see that the Piola transform arises naturally as the pullback on $2$-forms and that, as a consequence, it satisfies the crucial property}
\[
(p,\operatorname{div}v)_{L^2(\Omega)}=(\hat p,\operatorname{div}\hat v)_{L^2(\widehat\Omega)}.
\]
translated_text:
{在继续之前, 先用外微积分框架导出向量微积分中的一个结果, 它在混合有限元的发展中起着重要作用. (该结果的二维表述可参见例如 [\BookNumber{19}, Lemma 2.1.6].) 设 $p:\Omega\to\mathbb R$ 和 $v:\Omega\to\mathbb R^3$ 分别是 $\mathbb R^3$ 中区域 $\Omega$ 上的标量场和向量场, 考虑内积 $(p,\operatorname{div}v)_{L^2(\Omega)}$. 将散度视为 $2$-形式的外微分, 令 $\nu=v^1dx^2\wedge dx^3-v^2dx^1\wedge dx^3+v^3dx^1\wedge dx^2$ 为向量代理为 $v$ 的微分 $2$-形式. 则 $d\nu=(\operatorname{div}v)\operatorname{vol}$, 且 $(p,\operatorname{div}v)_{L^2(\Omega)}=\int_\Omega p\wedge d\nu$, 其中右端积分是微分形式意义下的积分. 再设 $\phi:\widehat\Omega\to\Omega$ 是保定向微分同胚, 应用积分 \eqref{eq:integration-pullback-invariance}, 外积 \eqref{eq:linear-pullback-wedge} 和外微分 \eqref{eq:exterior-derivative-pullback} 的拉回不变性, 将 $\Omega$ 上的积分变为 $\widehat\Omega$ 上的积分:}
\[
\int_\Omega p\wedge d\nu=\int_{\widehat\Omega}\phi^*(p\wedge d\nu)=\int_{\widehat\Omega}\phi^*p\wedge\phi^*d\nu=\int_{\widehat\Omega}\phi^*p\wedge d\phi^*\nu.
\]
{由场的拉回定义 \eqref{eq:smooth-pullback-definition}, 以及 Table~\ref{tab:exterior-algebra-r3} 底部给出的线性映射拉回公式, 可知 $\phi^*p=\hat p:=p\circ\phi$, 而 $\phi^*\nu$ 的代理场为向量场}
\[
\hat v=(\det\phi')(\phi')^{-1}(v\circ\phi):\widehat\Omega\to\mathbb R^3.
\]
{向量场 $\hat v$ 称为 $v$ 的 \emph{Piola 变换}. 可见, Piola 变换自然地作为 $2$-形式的拉回出现, 因而满足关键性质}
\[
(p,\operatorname{div}v)_{L^2(\Omega)}=(\hat p,\operatorname{div}\hat v)_{L^2(\widehat\Omega)}.
\]

source_text: \subsubsection{{The $L^2$ theory of differential forms}}\label{subsec:differential-forms-l2-theory}
translated_text: \subsubsection{{微分形式的 $L^2$ 理论}}\label{subsec:differential-forms-l2-theory}

source_text: {In this section we suppose that $\Omega$ is a smooth compact $n$-dimensional oriented Riemannian manifold with or without boundary and we view the exterior derivatives $d=d^k$ as closed densely defined unbounded operators from $L^2\Lambda^k(\Omega)$ to $L^2\Lambda^{k+1}(\Omega)$ which fit together to create the $L^2$ de Rham complex. We show that the exterior derivative operators all have closed range and compute their adjoints.}
translated_text: {本节假设 $\Omega$ 为光滑紧致 $n$ 维有定向 Riemannian 流形, 可以有边界或无边界; 将外微分 $d=d^k$ 看作从 $L^2\Lambda^k(\Omega)$ 到 $L^2\Lambda^{k+1}(\Omega)$ 的稠定闭无界算子, 它们组合构成 $L^2$ de Rham 复形. 我们将证明外微分算子都具有闭像, 并计算其伴随.}

source_text: {We now look to the integration-by-parts formula \eqref{eq:differential-forms-integration-by-parts} and establish conditions on $\omega$ and $\mu$ under which it is valid. It certainly holds for smooth $\omega$ and $\mu$ and therefore, by density, for $\omega\in H^1\Lambda^k$, $\mu\in H^1\Lambda^{n-k-1}$. In order to go further, we now show that the trace operator extends to a bounded operator on $H\Lambda^k(\Omega)$ with values in $H^{-1/2}\Lambda^k(\partial\Omega)$. Once this is accomplished, we can extend \eqref{eq:differential-forms-integration-by-parts} to the case when one of the forms belongs to $H\Lambda$ and the other to $H^1\Lambda$. (We cannot allow both forms in $H\Lambda$ unless at least one has vanishing trace, since otherwise we cannot make sense of the boundary integral.)}
translated_text: {现在考察分部积分公式 \eqref{eq:differential-forms-integration-by-parts}, 建立它对 $\omega$ 和 $\mu$ 成立的条件. 它当然对光滑的 $\omega$ 和 $\mu$ 成立, 因而由稠密性, 对 $\omega\in H^1\Lambda^k$, $\mu\in H^1\Lambda^{n-k-1}$ 成立. 为进一步推广, 现在证明迹算子可延拓为 $H\Lambda^k(\Omega)$ 上取值于 $H^{-1/2}\Lambda^k(\partial\Omega)$ 的有界算子. 完成后, 就可将 \eqref{eq:differential-forms-integration-by-parts} 延拓到一个形式属于 $H\Lambda$, 另一个属于 $H^1\Lambda$ 的情形. (除非至少一个形式的迹为零, 否则不能允许两个形式都在 $H\Lambda$ 中, 因为那样边界积分就没有意义.)}

source_text: {To continue with the study of the trace map, we assume that the boundary is Lipschitz in the sense that we can cover it with open sets $U$ of $\Omega$ that can be mapped by Lipschitz charts to a half ball $B=\{\,x\in\mathbb R^n\mid|x|=1,\ x^n\geq0\,\}$ with $U\cap\partial\Omega$ mapping to $B_0:=B\cap\{x^n=0\}$. The spaces $H^1\Lambda^k(U)$ and $H^{1/2}\Lambda^k(U\cap\partial\Omega)$ may then be defined as the pullbacks of the corresponding spaces on $B$ and $B_0$, respectively, and the spaces $H^1\Lambda^k(\Omega)$ and $H^{1/2}\Lambda^k(\partial\Omega)$ by piecing together these spaces with a partition of unity.}
translated_text: {为继续研究迹映射, 假设边界是 Lipschitz 的, 即可用 $\Omega$ 的开集 $U$ 覆盖它, 这些开集通过 Lipschitz 坐标图映到半球 $B=\{\,x\in\mathbb R^n\mid|x|=1,\ x^n\geq0\,\}$, 且 $U\cap\partial\Omega$ 映到 $B_0:=B\cap\{x^n=0\}$. 随后可将空间 $H^1\Lambda^k(U)$ 和 $H^{1/2}\Lambda^k(U\cap\partial\Omega)$ 分别定义为 $B$ 和 $B_0$ 上相应空间的拉回, 再通过单位分解将这些空间拼接起来, 定义空间 $H^1\Lambda^k(\Omega)$ 和 $H^{1/2}\Lambda^k(\partial\Omega)$.}

source_text: {Applying the duality Lemma~\ref{lem:dual-surjection-annihilator} as in the proof of Lemma~\ref{prop:trace-functional-representation}, we find that the dual of the trace map is a bounded linear injection whose range is the annihilator of the null space of the trace map, which gives the following corollary.}
translated_text: {像 Lemma~\ref{prop:trace-functional-representation} 的证明那样应用对偶性 Lemma~\ref{lem:dual-surjection-annihilator}, 可知迹映射的对偶是有界线性单射, 其像是迹映射零空间的零化子, 从而得到下述推论.}

source_text: {For the last statement we have just taken $h=\star g$, where the Hodge star is on the boundary (and the integral is meaningful by dense extension).}
translated_text: {最后一个陈述只需取 $h=\star g$, 其中 Hodge 星算子位于边界上 (积分通过稠密延拓而有意义).}

source_text:
{Now, if $\mu\in H\Lambda^{n-k-1}$ and $\omega\in H^1\Lambda^k$ satisfies $\operatorname{tr}\omega=0$, then we have}
\[
\int_\Omega d\omega\wedge\mu-(-)^k\int_\Omega\omega\wedge d\mu=0.
\]
{(It is certainly so if $\mu\in H^1\Lambda^{n-k-1}$ and extends to $\mu\in H\Lambda$ by density.) Therefore, for any such $\mu$, we may apply the corollary to the functional}
\[
L_\mu\omega:=\int_\Omega d\omega\wedge\mu-(-)^k\int_\Omega\omega\wedge d\mu
\]
{and conclude that there exists a unique $\gamma\mu\in H^{-1/2}\Lambda^{n-k-1}(\partial\Omega)$ such that}
\[
\int_\Omega d\omega\wedge\mu-(-)^k\int_\Omega\omega\wedge d\mu=\int_{\partial\Omega}\operatorname{tr}\omega\wedge\gamma\mu,\qquad\omega\in H^1\Lambda^k.
\]
{Clearly $\gamma\mu=\operatorname{tr}\mu$ if $\mu$ is smooth, say, in $H^1\Lambda^{n-k-1}$. In this way we have extended the trace operator on $H^1\Lambda^{n-k-1}$ to a bounded operator mapping}
\[
H\Lambda^{n-k-1}(\Omega)\to H^{-1/2}\Lambda^{n-k-1}(\partial\Omega).
\]
{Henceforth we shall denote the extended operator by $\operatorname{tr}$ rather than $\gamma$. We summarize in the following theorem.}
translated_text:
{现在, 若 $\mu\in H\Lambda^{n-k-1}$, 且 $\omega\in H^1\Lambda^k$ 满足 $\operatorname{tr}\omega=0$, 则有}
\[
\int_\Omega d\omega\wedge\mu-(-)^k\int_\Omega\omega\wedge d\mu=0.
\]
{(若 $\mu\in H^1\Lambda^{n-k-1}$, 这当然成立, 再由稠密性延拓到 $\mu\in H\Lambda$.) 因此, 对任意这样的 $\mu$, 可将该推论应用于泛函}
\[
L_\mu\omega:=\int_\Omega d\omega\wedge\mu-(-)^k\int_\Omega\omega\wedge d\mu
\]
{并得出存在唯一 $\gamma\mu\in H^{-1/2}\Lambda^{n-k-1}(\partial\Omega)$, 使得}
\[
\int_\Omega d\omega\wedge\mu-(-)^k\int_\Omega\omega\wedge d\mu=\int_{\partial\Omega}\operatorname{tr}\omega\wedge\gamma\mu,\qquad\omega\in H^1\Lambda^k.
\]
{显然, 若 $\mu$ 光滑, 例如属于 $H^1\Lambda^{n-k-1}$, 则 $\gamma\mu=\operatorname{tr}\mu$. 由此将 $H^1\Lambda^{n-k-1}$ 上的迹算子延拓为有界算子}
\[
H\Lambda^{n-k-1}(\Omega)\to H^{-1/2}\Lambda^{n-k-1}(\partial\Omega).
\]
{以下将此延拓算子记为 $\operatorname{tr}$ 而不是 $\gamma$. 概括为下述定理.}

source_text: {We close this chapter with a few more useful results.}
translated_text: {本章最后再给出几个有用的结果.}

source_text:
{The $L^2$ theory of the operator $\delta$ can be obtained analogously to the treatment just given for $d$. Alternatively, the properties of $\delta$ may be derived from those of $d$ via the Hodge star. We may view $\delta$ as a closed densely defined operator on $L^2\Lambda^k$ with domain}
\[
H^*\Lambda^k(\Omega)=\{\,\omega\in L^2\Lambda^k\mid\delta\omega\in L^2\Lambda^{k-1}\,\}=\star H\Lambda^{n-k}(\Omega).
\]
translated_text:
{算子 $\delta$ 的 $L^2$ 理论可以仿照刚才对 $d$ 的处理得到. 或者, 也可以通过 Hodge 星算子, 由 $d$ 的性质导出 $\delta$ 的性质. 可将 $\delta$ 看作 $L^2\Lambda^k$ 上的稠定闭算子, 定义域为}
\[
H^*\Lambda^k(\Omega)=\{\,\omega\in L^2\Lambda^k\mid\delta\omega\in L^2\Lambda^{k-1}\,\}=\star H\Lambda^{n-k}(\Omega).
\]

source_text:
{For each of the first two operators, we have corresponding Hilbert cochain complexes, namely, the de Rham cochain complexes \eqref{eq:l2-manifold-de-rham-complex} and \eqref{eq:boundary-manifold-de-rham-complex} without and with boundary conditions, respectively. (The last two operators similarly form Hilbert chain complexes that are essentially identical to the corresponding de Rham complexes except for a change of indexing.) As a consequence of the result of Picard, discussed in Section~\ref{sec:l2-de-rham-complex}, each of these complexes satisfies the compactness property, and so all the operators have closed range, and all the complexes are Fredholm. Knowing the adjoints, we can write down the strong form of the Hodge Laplace boundary value problem associated to the two complexes. For each the differential equation is the Hodge Laplace equation}
\[
(d^{k-1}\delta_k+\delta_{k+1}d^k)u=f
\]
{or, dropping sub- and superscripts, $(d\delta+\delta d)u=f$. For the complex \eqref{eq:l2-manifold-de-rham-complex} the boundary conditions, implied by the requirements that $u$ and $du$ must belong to the domain $d^*$, are}
\[
\operatorname{tr}\star u=0,\qquad\operatorname{tr}\star du=0\quad\text{on }\partial\Omega.
\]
translated_text:
{对前两个算子各自都有相应的 Hilbert 上链复形, 即分别为不带和带边界条件的 de Rham 上链复形 \eqref{eq:l2-manifold-de-rham-complex} 和 \eqref{eq:boundary-manifold-de-rham-complex}. (最后两个算子类似地构成 Hilbert 链复形, 除指标变化外, 它们与相应的 de Rham 复形本质上相同.) 由 Section~\ref{sec:l2-de-rham-complex} 讨论的 Picard 的结果可知, 这些复形各自都满足紧性性质, 从而所有算子都具有闭像, 所有复形都是 Fredholm 的. 知道伴随后, 就可写出与这两个复形相伴的 Hodge Laplace 边值问题的强表述. 对每一个复形, 微分方程都是 Hodge Laplace 方程}
\[
(d^{k-1}\delta_k+\delta_{k+1}d^k)u=f
\]
{或者省略上下标, 写为 $(d\delta+\delta d)u=f$. 对复形 \eqref{eq:l2-manifold-de-rham-complex}, 由要求 $u$ 和 $du$ 必须属于定义域 $d^*$ 所蕴含的边界条件为}
\[
\operatorname{tr}\star u=0,\qquad\operatorname{tr}\star du=0\quad\text{on }\partial\Omega.
\]

source_text: {The interpretation of these boundary conditions in three dimensions was discussed in Section~\ref{sec:hodge-r3} and summarized in Table~\ref{tab:hodge-r3-boundary-conditions}. For $k=0$, the case of the scalar Laplacian, the first boundary condition is vacuous, while the second states that $(\operatorname{grad}u)\cdot n=0$, given \emph{Neumann boundary conditions}. For $k=1$, these are magnetic boundary conditions and for $k=2$ electric boundary conditions, and for $k=3$ they impose Dirichlet boundary conditions.}
translated_text: {这些边界条件在三维中的解释, 已在 Section~\ref{sec:hodge-r3} 中讨论, 并概括于 Table~\ref{tab:hodge-r3-boundary-conditions}. 对 $k=0$, 即标量 Laplacian 的情形, 第一个边界条件为空条件, 第二个则说明 $(\operatorname{grad}u)\cdot n=0$, 给出 \emph{Neumann 边界条件}. 对 $k=1$, 它们是磁边界条件; 对 $k=2$, 是电边界条件; 对 $k=3$, 它们施加 Dirichlet 边界条件.}

source_text:
{A \emph{differential $k$-form} on a manifold assigns an element of $\operatorname{Alt}^k$ of the tangent space to each point. All the operations above carry over to differential forms. In addition, a differential $k$-form $\omega$ admits an exterior derivative $d\omega$, which is a differential $(k+1)$-form. The exterior derivative satisfies $d\circ d=0$ and the Leibniz rule:}
\[
d(\omega\wedge\mu)=d\omega\wedge\mu+(-)^k\omega\wedge d\mu,\qquad\omega\in\Lambda^k(\Omega),\ \mu\in\Lambda^j(\Omega).
\]
translated_text:
{流形上的\emph{微分 $k$-形式}在每一点指定切空间的 $\operatorname{Alt}^k$ 中的一个元素. 上述所有运算都可推广到微分形式. 此外, 微分 $k$-形式 $\omega$ 具有外微分 $d\omega$, 它是微分 $(k+1)$-形式. 外微分满足 $d\circ d=0$ 和 Leibniz 法则:}
\[
d(\omega\wedge\mu)=d\omega\wedge\mu+(-)^k\omega\wedge d\mu,\qquad\omega\in\Lambda^k(\Omega),\ \mu\in\Lambda^j(\Omega).
\]
